items.informal_name: Image of a Finite Set is Finite
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} {s : Set α} (f : α → β), s.Finite → (f '' s).Finite
items.informal_description: For any function $ f : \alpha \to \beta $ and any finite subset $ s \subseteq \alpha $, the image $ \{ f(a) \mid a \in s \} $ is a finite set in $ \beta $.

items.informal_name: Image of a Finite Set under a Function is Finite
items.type: ∀ {α β : Type u_1} {s : Set α} (f : α → β), s.Finite → (f <$> s).Finite
items.informal_description: If $ s $ is a finite subset of a type $ \alpha $ and $ f : \alpha \to \beta $ is a function, then the image $ f(s) = \{ f(a) \mid a \in s \} $ is a finite subset of $ \beta $.

items.informal_name: Image of a Finite Set Under a Function is Finite
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u} {β : Type v} (s : Set α) (f : α → β) [Finite ↑s], Finite ↑(f '' s)
items.informal_description: The image of a finite set under any function is finite.

items.informal_name: The Image of a Finite Set under a Function is Finite
items.type: {α : Type u} → {β : Type v} → [DecidableEq β] → (s : Set α) → (f : α → β) → [Fintype ↑s] → Fintype ↑(f '' s)
items.informal_description: If $ s $ is a finite subset of $ \alpha $ and $ f : \alpha \to \beta $ is a function, then the image $ f(s) $ is a finite subset of $ \beta $. This instance constructs the finite type structure on the image by converting $ s $ to a finite set (Finset), applying $ f $ to each element, and deduplicating the results to form the image Finset, which inherits finiteness from the original set.

items.informal_name: The Image of a Finite Set under a Function is Finite
items.type: {α β : Type u_1} → [DecidableEq β] → (s : Set α) → (f : α → β) → [Fintype ↑s] → Fintype ↑(f <$> s)
items.informal_description: If $ s $ is a finite subset of a type $ \alpha $ and $ f : \alpha \to \beta $ is any function, then the image $ f(s) $ is a finite subset of $ \beta $. This instance establishes that the property of finiteness is preserved under the image operation of sets.
